No clause explicitly covers delivery of clinical results to a person, and the **U8-1-23-delivery-definition** and **G6-9.2.3.15-tp-status** do not address this scenario either. The **G6-3-sme-definition** is irrelevant as it does not address delivery obligations. Thus, no clause governs this step.
